mapper.sql:
JOIN ( SELECT cur_ti.item_id AS item_id, MIN(cur_n.sort) AS current_sort FROM task_instance cur_ti JOIN item_task_node cur_n ON cur_n.id = cur_ti.item_task_node_id AND cur_n.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE cur_ti.deleted_at IS NULL AND cur_ti.status IN (1, 2) GROUP BY cur_ti.item_id ) cur ON cur.item_id = ti.item_id
AND n.sort = cur.current_sort
mapper.select: SELECT n.item_id AS itemId, n.sort AS sort FROM item_task_node n WHERE n.deleted_at IS NULL AND n.item_id IN #{id} ORDER BY n.item_id, n.sort

SELECT n.item_id AS itemId, n.id AS nodeId, n.name AS nodeName, n.sort AS sort, n.parallel_sort AS parallelSort, (COUNT(ti.id) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ti.status = 3 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 0) AS completed FROM item_task_node n LEFT JOIN task_instance ti ON ti.item_task_node_id = n.id AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE n.deleted_at IS NULL AND n.item_id IN #{id} GROUP BY n.item_id, n.id, n.name, n.sort, n.parallel_sort
